mechanics: Place deadly Bear Traps around the map that injure and immobilize Survivors who step in them
Can carry up to 2 Bear Traps at a time
Setting a trap grants +7.5% Haste for 5 seconds
Trapped Survivors can attempt escape (16.67% chance per attempt, max 6 attempts) or wait for rescue
The Trapper can also step in his own traps, causing carried Survivors to escape
Ring the Wailing Bell to Cloak, becoming invisible and gaining +50% speed
While Cloaked, cannot attack but can traverse the map quickly
Uncloak to surprise Survivors - brief speed burst after uncloaking
Survivors can hear the bell from a distance
Body-blocking while cloaked reveals shimmer effect
Sprint across the map at high speed with the Chainsaw
Instantly down any Survivor hit during a Chainsaw Sprint
Chainsaw generates Heat - overheat causes a temporary cooldown
Requires skill to steer around obstacles
Great for map traversal and ending chases quickly
Blink (teleport) through walls and obstacles
Chain up to 2 Blinks in quick succession
After Blinking, suffer Fatigue (cannot attack briefly)
Ignores pallets and windows completely
High skill ceiling - master Blink distances
Stalk Survivors to build Evil Within (3 tiers)
Tier 1: Very small Terror Radius, reduced lunge, 105% speed
Tier 2: Normal Terror Radius, normal lunge, 115% speed
Tier 3: Exposed effect on all Survivors, extended lunge, increased vault speed
Tier 3 is temporary unless using Tombstone add-ons
Static Blast: Shock all Survivors in Terror Radius, revealing their location
Shock Therapy: Short-range shock that prevents actions briefly
Build up Madness tiers on Survivors (I, II, III)
Higher Madness causes hallucinations, screaming, and skill check difficulties
Survivors at Tier III cannot heal until they Snap Out of It
Throw hatchets to injure Survivors from a distance
Can carry up to 5 hatchets (refill at Lockers)
Hatchets require wind-up time before throwing
Reduced movement speed while aiming
Becomes 110% movement speed killer (4.4 m/s)
Crouch to move stealthily (no Terror Radius, slower speed)
Ambush Dash: Lunge attack from crouch position
Place Reverse Bear Traps on downed Survivors
Active RBTs start timer when a generator is completed
Survivors must search Jigsaw Boxes to remove the trap before timer expires (death)
Phase Walk: Become invisible and leave a husk behind
While phasing, move at 176% speed but cannot see Survivors
Track Survivors by Scratch Marks and sound (grass, footsteps)
Survivors cannot see you during Phase Walk
Mind-game with passive Phasing (briefly invisible while walking)
Crouch to reduce detection, activate Night Shroud while crouched
Night Shroud: No Terror Radius, no Red Stain
Stalk Survivors to Mark them (Exposed for 45 seconds)
Leaning around corners increases Stalk rate
Survivors can reveal you by looking at you to break Night Shroud
Shred: Lunge attack that can hit Survivors and break pallets
Place Portals around the map (up to 6)
Traverse between Portals to quickly move across the map
Detect Survivors near Portals with Killer Instinct
Survivors can seal Portals to destroy them
Start the trial with 36 Blades and a 24m Terror Radius while moving at 4.4 m/s
Distinct back-to-back actions generate Style Points that raise you from E-Rank to S-Rank
Higher Style Ranks improve Blade throw rate and Locker restocking speed
At S-Rank, Survivors within 44m are revealed by Killer Instinct for 4.4 seconds and Main Event becomes available
Main Event lasts 10 seconds, throws Blades at 1.67x speed, then triggers a 4-second power cooldown
Strike with a targeted ground attack to force survivors off direct paths
Summon masses of vines to deny routes and punish stalled movement
Traverse the map through the Upside Down to ambush generators, rescues, and rotations
Use Worldbreaker pressure to snowball when survivors hesitate in unsafe spaces
Pair traversal and zoning so survivors are punished whether they hold position or panic-rotate
Vanish into a Mist Cloud and reposition unseen across the map
Jump Scare from hiding spots to reveal survivors and gain early chase pressure
Plant Hook Spikes to punish predictable lanes, walls, and choke points
Use vanishing traversal to cut off rotations before survivors commit to tiles
Convert tile chaos into downs by mixing stealth pressure with basic-attack chases
Hold the Power button to control a column of Divine Light, then cast it forward to damage and inflict Heresy

The longer Divine Light is controlled, the shorter the cast delay and the longer the cast duration; near-misses reveal Killer Instinct; steering curves over 0.8s while Zealous and 0.3s when not Zealous

Heretics (survivors with Heresy) suffer special skill checks while repairing and can be sent to the Exile from the Dying State; liberated Exiles respawn at least 32m away with 1s of Divine Light immunity
Exiling a Heretic triggers Zealous for 60 seconds, increasing Divine Light's size, cast duration, and control window
Survivors repent at Shrines of Judgment to remove Heresy or rescue the Exiled, and taunting The Judgment inflicts Heresy
